item.description:
Notex 0.2.4
Clearer summaries for short recordings
- Summaries now need at least 50 transcript words. Short recordings still save normally, with an inline message explaining why a summary is unavailable. - Open Transcript to read a short recording's saved text. The sidebar notice no longer makes the window taller; narrow windows can still widen slightly to fit the sidebar.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.3
Better editing and recording diagnostics
- Improved native editing, table cell selection, and Undo. - Use Insert in Note to add assistant answers while preserving headings and lists. - Choose sorting and date grouping for individual folders. - Finish and save an active recording when quitting Notex. - Added crash reports and recording reliability counts to help investigate failures. Audio, transcripts, and note content are excluded. Turn off Share diagnostic data in Settings > General > Diagnostics to stop sharing. - Refined the app icon, appearance controls, and recording cards.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.2
Readable assistant icons in Dark Mode
- Fixed provider icons appearing black in the Chat menu in Dark Mode. - Provider marks now follow native menu foreground, highlight, and disabled colors. Notex actions retain your chosen accent.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
